title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for portland pozzolana cement used in construction of buildings, roads, bridges and general civil engineering works, including composition, physical and chemical requirements.
normative_references: IS 4032:1985 Chemical analysis of hydraulic cement
certification: BIS Product Certification (ISI Mark) - Mandatory under Cement (Quality Control) Order

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 53 Grade — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for 53 grade ordinary portland cement used in high-strength concrete structures.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for grading, quality and physical properties of aggregates for use in concrete.
normative_references: IS 2386 Methods of test for aggregates for concrete
certification: Not mandatory for BIS certification; quality control recommended per IS 456

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
scope: Code of practice for general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings and structures.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for high strength deformed steel bars used for reinforcement of concrete structures.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for hot rolled steel plates, sections, and bars for general structural purposes.
normative_references: IS 228 Methods of chemical analysis of steel

title: General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice
scope: General code of practice for use of structural steel in general building and structural engineering.

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
scope: Covers electrical wiring installations for voltages up to 650V for buildings, factories and public premises.
certification: Not directly certified; components used must carry BIS/ISI marks

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100V — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for PVC insulated electric cables for low voltage wiring in buildings.
normative_references: IS 10810 Methods of test for cables

title: Code of Practice for Earthing
scope: Provides guidance for earthing of electrical installations for safety of personnel and equipment.
normative_references: IS 5:2007 Colours for ready mixed paints (earthing colour codes)

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — General Requirements
scope: General safety requirements applicable to household electrical appliances such as irons, mixers, heaters.

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety, General Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for information technology equipment including personal computers, printers, and related devices.
certification: BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) - Mandatory for laptops, PCs

title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus — Safety Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for audio, video, and similar electronic apparatus for household and general use.

title: Safety of Household Electric Water Heaters — Particular Requirements
scope: Particular safety requirements for household electric storage-type water heaters (geysers).

title: Safety of Household Refrigerating Appliances — Particular Requirements
scope: Particular safety requirements for household refrigerators and freezers.

title: Refrigerating Appliances, Frost-free Household Refrigerators — Specification
scope: Specifies performance and energy consumption requirements for frost-free household refrigerators.
normative_references: IS 7859 Methods of test for refrigerators
certification: BEE Star Labelling applicable; BIS registration under CRS

title: Safety of Household Electric Mixers, Grinders and Blenders — Particular Requirements
scope: Particular safety requirements for household mixer-grinders and blenders.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables — For Working Voltages up to 1100V
scope: Specifies requirements for heavy duty PVC insulated cables used in industrial power distribution.

title: Electrical Safety of Portable Motor-operated Tools
scope: Particular safety requirements for hand-held motor operated electric tools such as drills, grinders.

title: Toys — Safety Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for toys intended for use by children including mechanical, physical, flammability and chemical safety.
normative_references: IS 9873 Methods of test for safety of toys
certification: BIS Product Certification (ISI Mark) - Mandatory for toys

title: Safety of Toys — Mechanical and Physical Properties
scope: Specifies mechanical and physical safety requirements for toys including small parts, sharp edges, and choking hazards.

title: Safety of Toys — Migration of Certain Elements
scope: Specifies limits for migration of toxic elements such as lead, cadmium, mercury from toy materials.

title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts — Product Grade C
scope: Specifies dimensions and tolerances for hexagon head bolts of product grade C used in general engineering.
certification: Not mandatory BIS certification; quality per IS 1367

title: Technical Supply Conditions for Threaded Steel Fasteners — Mechanical Properties
scope: Specifies mechanical property requirements and test methods for threaded steel fasteners (bolts, screws, studs).

title: Drinking Water — Specification
scope: Specifies quality requirements for drinking water for human consumption including physical, chemical and biological parameters.
normative_references: IS 3025 Methods of sampling and testing water
certification: BIS Product Certification (ISI Mark) - Mandatory for packaged drinking water

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for packaged natural mineral water including source, processing and packaging standards.
certification: BIS Product Certification (ISI Mark) - Mandatory; FSSAI license required

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement — Determination of Consistency
scope: Prescribes test methods for determining standard consistency of hydraulic cement paste.
certification: Test method standard - not for certification

title: Solar Photovoltaic Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval
scope: Specifies design qualification and type approval requirements for terrestrial photovoltaic modules made of crystalline silicon.
certification: BIS/MNRE Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) required

title: Photovoltaic Devices — Measurement of Photovoltaic Current-Voltage Characteristics
scope: Specifies methods for measurement of current-voltage characteristics of photovoltaic devices.

title: Mild Steel Tubes — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for mild steel tubes used for general engineering, structural, water and gas piping purposes.
normative_references: IS 1387:1993 General requirements for supply of metallurgical materials

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supply — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for uPVC pipes used for potable cold water supply.
normative_references: IS 12235 Methods of test for uPVC pipes

title: Polyethylene (PE) Pipes for Water Supply — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for high density polyethylene pipes used for cold water supply and irrigation.

title: Method for Brinell Hardness Test for Metallic Materials
scope: Specifies method for determination of Brinell hardness of metallic materials.

title: Metallic Materials — Tensile Testing at Ambient Temperature
scope: Specifies method for tensile testing of metallic materials at room temperature.

title: Design Loads for Buildings and Structures — Wind Loads
scope: Specifies wind load design criteria for buildings and structures.

title: Hot-dip Zinc Coating on Structural Steel Sections — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for hot-dip galvanized zinc coating on fabricated structural steel.
normative_references: IS 6745:1990 Methods for determination of mass of zinc coating
certification: Not mandatory BIS; recommended for corrosion protection quality

title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Water and Wastewater — Chloride
scope: Specifies method for determination of chloride content in water and wastewater.

title: Lithium-ion Cells and Batteries used in Portable Applications — Safety Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for secondary lithium-ion cells and batteries used in portable electronic devices such as mobile phones and laptops.

title: Lithium-ion Batteries for Electric Vehicles — Safety Requirements
scope: Safety and performance requirements for lithium-ion traction battery packs used in electric vehicles.
certification: BIS/ARAI Certification - Mandatory for EV battery packs

title: Safety of Household Washing Machines — Particular Requirements
scope: Particular safety requirements applicable to household washing machines and clothes dryers.

title: Random Sampling and Randomization Methods
scope: Provides methods for random sampling and randomization used in quality control and statistical process control.

title: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (HACCP) System — Requirements
scope: Specifies requirements for food safety management systems based on HACCP principles.
allied_standards: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards Regulations

title: General Requirements for Batch Type Concrete Mixers
scope: Specifies general requirements for batch type concrete mixers used in construction.
